facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of South Africa issued by Government Gazette notice 4138 of 4 September 2026 an Electoral Code of Conduct binding on parties and candidates until results are declared, which requires AI-generated 'synthetic content' to be labelled before distribution and bars deceptive synthetic content intended to mislead.
